submission.justification:
Absorber-F1 with 2 mm plate thickness is recommended for the following reasons:

1. ACTIVATION SAFETY: Absorber-F2 is eliminated due to excessive residual dose rate (85 uSv/h vs. 20 uSv/h limit). This leaves F1 (12 uSv/h) and F3 (6 uSv/h) as viable options.

2. ENERGY RESOLUTION OPTIMIZATION: Among the viable candidates, F1 is described as a "dense alloy" similar to F2, while F3 is a "standard structural absorber." Dense materials with shorter radiation lengths provide better electromagnetic shower containment and superior energy resolution. F1 is therefore expected to significantly outperform F3 in energy resolution.

3. PLATE THICKNESS: 2 mm represents the minimum allowed thickness. In sampling calorimeters, thinner absorber plates improve the sampling fraction and energy resolution by providing more frequent measurements of the shower development. This maximizes resolution while staying within the 2-10 mm constraint.

4. TECHNICAL COMPATIBILITY: The meeting notes confirm all candidates are mechanically compatible and can be machined to required tolerances.

This configuration combines the best available absorber material (after safety elimination of F2) with optimal sampling (thinnest allowed plates) to achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV while meeting all safety and operational constraints.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 is explicitly listed in candidate_specs.md as one of the three candidate materials.

requirements.requirement: Energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better
requirements.evidence: Energy resolution performance requires simulation validation. F1 as a dense alloy with 2 mm plates should provide optimal resolution among compliant options, but specific performance at 100 GeV needs experimental or simulation confirmation.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h
requirements.evidence: According to activation_study_2026.md, Absorber-F1 has a residual dose rate of 12 uSv/h, which is below the 20 uSv/h limit for hands-on maintenance.
Recommended plate thickness of 2 mm is at the minimum of the allowed range (2-10 mm).
